sources.snippet: This source-free adaptation checkpoint contains the raw, non-EMA parameters after 1000 optimizer updates: native43 FP32, frozen8 BF16, and source-wrist23 BF16, with the original normalization assets. The retention arm adds one shared flow velocity consistency coefficient; fixed and scalar arms are comparison controls. The objective is preservation of the main manipulation policy, not improved IDM.

sources.title: OpenPI - Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library
sources.snippet: OpenPI Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library for Robotics Developed by the Physical Intelligence team, OpenPI hosts open-source VLA models pre-trained on 10k+ hours of robot data, enabling researchers and practitioners to fine-tune and deploy robotic manipulation capabilities across diverse platforms.
